deck_title: Lambert spherical cap projected solid angle vs naive unprojected cosine ratio rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Johann Heinrich Lambert (1760 Photometria) spherical cap projected solid angle law (across 17 cap height stations u = 1 - cos(gamma) in [0.0000, 1.0000], unprojected solid angle is Omega = 2*pi*u while cosine-weighted projected solid angle is Omega_perp = pi*sin^2(gamma) = 2*pi*u*(1 - 0.5*u), so mean cap cosine <cos(theta)>_cap = (1 + cos(gamma))/2 = 1 - 0.5*u and its obliquity complement 0.5*u lock normalized irradiance conservation at R = 1.0000x with 0/17 misweighted stations) versus naive uncompensated solid-angle ratio (which drops as 1 - 0.5*u to 0.8750x at u=0.25, 0.7500x at 60 deg, and 0.5000x / pi-vs-2pi at 90 deg hemisphere across 16/17 stations) and 64-ring spherical zonal quadrature.
